Simulated spiking neurons (1M on GPU / 20k on CPU) inside the real wiring of one person's brain; each drawn cell stands for a sampled model neuron; a model, not a mind.
Shapes are real reconstructed neurons from public datasets (H01 human cortex electron microscopy, Shapson-Coe et al. 2024; NeuroMorpho.Org), CC BY 4.0. The activity is simulated by a point-neuron network and slowed down to be visible. A model, not a mind.
